preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 5 * 10**5 and 1 <= m <= 5 * 10**5 for n, m in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()[:2]])
preconditions.description: Input integers n (number of vectors) and m (dimensions) satisfy 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 5 ⋅ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) >= 1 and len(line.split()) <= 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n subsequent lines describes a vector with either 1 or 2 coordinates set to 1 (k ∈ {1, 2}).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All coordinate indices in the vectors are between 1 and m (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(int(x) for x in line.split()[1:])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) == n
preconditions.description: No two vectors in S are identical (all vectors are unique).

postconditions.description: First line of output contains two integers: the size of T modulo 10^9+7 and the size of the minimal subset S'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: Second line contains indices of vectors in S' (1-based, ascending order).

postconditions.expression: len(set(int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())) == int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[1])
postconditions.description: The indices in the second line are unique and correspond to |S'| distinct vectors.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) and sorted(int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) == list(int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: Indices in S' are in strictly ascending order and lexicographically smallest among all minimal subsets.

postconditions.expression: T == {tuple(sum((int(line.split()[i+j] in x) for j in range(1, len(line.split()))) for i in range(0, len(line.split())-1, len(line.split())-1)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) for x in itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=len(S'))}
postconditions.description: The set T is the span of S' (all possible sums of subsets of S' generate all vectors in T).

postconditions.expression: not any(len(S'') < len(S') and T == {tuple(sum((int(line.split()[i+j] in x) for j in range(1, len(line.split()))) for i in range(0, len(line.split())-1, len(line.split())-1)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) for x in itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=len(S''))} for S'' in itertools.combinations(range(1, n+1), len(S')-1))
postconditions.description: S' is a minimal subset of S such that its span equals T (no smaller subset exists).
